notes: Clay is printed 50' north of 12th and 33' south of 12th (centreline shifts ~12 px west south of 12th; 12th point is the average). East 12th Street meets Main twice: from the west at y~2308 and the offset segment east of Main at y~1792 (label 'E. 12TH'). The street east of Main printed 'WOODWARD' on this sheet is printed 'E. 13TH (WOODWARD)' on sheets 147, 148 and 152 (where the next street north, old Franklin, is printed 'WOODWARD (FRANKLIN)'), so it is named East 13th Street here to avoid a clash; it is offset ~140 px south of East 13th west of Main, so Main has two separate East 13th T points. An unnamed 10 ft alley leaves Main eastward at y~2318, just south of the West-side 12th point (it is fully drawn on sheet 147); Cassatt Alley is not drawn on this sheet. West of Clay a narrow (~6-8 ft) unnamed strip with a water pipe runs from Walnut to Clay in line with Wilkeymacky Alley (between the Cigar Factory block and the Ohio Mechanics Institute), so Clay/Wilkeymacky is marked cross. The parkway paste covers the former canal; it is labelled '(E.N. CANAL)' / 'E. CENTRAL PARKWAY' / '(E.S. CANAL)'. Points are on the north bank street (block line ~3540 to canal water edge ~3710) and the south bank street (canal edge ~3890 to block line ~4050) centrelines. Walnut centre is ~1208 north of the canal but ~1232 on the south side (blocks on 138). Bowen Alley name read from sheet 138 (the gap between the two 138 reference blocks).
